lcc_original: 洗拉也生了土八該隱，就是打造各樣銅鐵利器的；土八該隱的妹子是拿瑪。
notes: UNV 又<WAH01571> → LCC 也: semantic equivalents (both mean 'also/moreover'); SN attached to 也
{<WAH01931>} kept implicit: LCC has no explicit pronoun for the implied subject (Zillah)
{<WAH0853>} kept implicit: direct object marker (את) is always implicit in Chinese
UNV '他是打造' → LCC '就是打造': 就是 is a resumptive copula with no Hebrew equivalent; SNs attach to 打造 only
UNV parenthetical (或譯：是銅匠鐵匠的祖師) absent from LCC — no SN impact
LCC writes 土八該隱 without UNV's middle dot (‧); LCC's orthography preserved
